title: Xecute
tagline: X-Ecute redefines onchain trading with AI. Powered by Coinbase’s AgentKit, it delivers lightning-fast execution, real-time insights, and smart, automated strategies—empowering you to trade boldly in decentralized markets.
description:
X-Ecute is an innovative AI-powered onchain trading platform that was meant to redefine how traders interact with decentralized markets. Built using Coinbase’s AgentKit, it is supposed to seamlessly integrate secure wallet connectivity, ensuring that every trade is executed with precision and safety directly on the blockchain.

The platform features an intuitive, button-driven interface where users easily input key trade parameters—such as limit orders and stop-loss thresholds—without needing to write complex commands. These user inputs are transformed into smart AI prompts that automate trade execution, merging human insight with the speed and reliability of onchain operations.
how_its_made: This project is not complete. The AI part is not working. Nothing really is, as there was no clear guide on integrating with the frontend. I kept meeting errors that I could not get help from anywhere. The project uses Next.js and TypeScript for the frontend and was supposed to use Coinbase's AgentKit with some predefined prompts to help handle some tasks when certain buttons were clicked or certain commands were used.
